pgn.notes: XLSX versions used (the CSV versions are kept too but use mixed encodings). Values are counts of victim rows by area and one field at a time (Total, SEXO/GÉNERO, RANGO DE EDAD, TIPO DE ARMA UTILIZADA, MES). The 2020 file also has VICTIMAS = "Femicidio" (31 rows), kept as its own measure; other years list only "Homicidio". Area spellings vary by year (e.g. "Colón " with trailing space, "BOCAS DEL TORO", "Comarca_Ngäbe_Buglé") and are kept as published in area_id. ano-2024.xlsx: AÑO column holds 294 distinct values (2024, 2025, 2026, 2027, ...), apparently a fill-down error; all rows counted under the file's year 2024

problems: The source reports "Panamá (San Miguelito)" separately from "Panamá"; San Miguelito is linked to its geoBoundaries ADM2 polygon, and "Panamá" to the whole Panamá province polygon (which also contains San Miguelito).
